title: Singleton Optimality in Standard Quadratic Programs with the GOE
summary: We study the standard quadratic optimization problem over the simplex when the objective matrix is drawn from the Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE). Let \(κ_n\) denote the support size of the almost surely unique global optimizer. We prove \[ \Prob(κ_n>1)\sim 2\sqrt{2π}\,\frac{\sqrt{\log n}}{n}. \] The proof combines an exact two-coordinate condition for edge improvement with a product formula obtained by conditioning on the diagonal order statistics.
